To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
AGOA has been successful in increasing the number of countries and products that benefit from preferences, but the EBA and CBI have been more successful in increasing exports to the US and the EU.
the SR in AGOA has led to an increase in export volumes to the US market by about 300% and to an increase in the export value by 500% for the top beneficiaries of AGOA.
AGOA’s special regime has led to an increase in exports to the United States of about 300 percent for a group of African beneficiary countries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of the PSRO on export diversification and on export performance of the African apparel industry.
the impact of rules of origin (ROO) on the diversification of export patterns of African countries.
the impact of the different rules of origin on the export performance of beneficiary countries.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PSRO are a key determinant of the diversification potential of African apparel exports.
AGOA’s special regime has been successful in diversifying exports and in promoting export growth.
the PSRO in AGOA’s SR are more liberal and have a more positive impact on export diversification and export volumes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PSRO matter for export performance and diversification, but the impact is not uniform across products.
AGOA’s SR is a success for African apparel exporters and the EBA is not.
the PSRO of the US-Africa trade agreement (AGOA) is superior to the EU-Africa trade agreement in terms of promoting export diversification in the apparel sector.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the SR in AGOA has had a significant effect on the diversification and volume of African apparel exports, and that the EU’s EBA and COTONOU agreements have had a smaller, but still positive effect on the volume and diversification of exports to the EU.
the SR is a key factor behind AGOA’s success in boosting apparel exports to the US from Africa.
the PSRO of AGOA’s special regime has had a significant positive impact on the diversification of apparel exports from the top seven beneficiaries to the US.
